summary.text: Every network puts a signed contract or a reviewed request before certification, then builds the test cases from each partner's own configuration.
Visa and Mastercard hand user provisioning to administrators inside the partner. Mastercard wants one Business Administrator and two Security Administrators, named on a form sent by email.
Host certification is still led by a network representative. Visa's published host path runs from a CIQ and testing questionnaire through attended VCMS testing to a letter and production flags.

Each network closes certification with a different artefact. Mastercard sends a TAN letter, Visa a completion letter or a CCRT email, Discover a letter listing cases, and Amex a summary plus live terminal parameters.
All four run self-certification or accredited third-party routes for terminals. These routes are how processors and platforms certify once for many clients.
The clearest progress tracking in public view belongs to Amex's AMEX Enabled dashboard for vendors and UnionPay's project record. Mastercard and Visa show tracking for access orders and admin tasks.

Published turnarounds are few and cover the network's own steps. Examples are EASI review in two business days, PULSE credentials in five, Amex Knowledge Base access in three and a Mastercard CIS project number in several days.
The Discover family onboards partners through separate doors: EASI, the PULSE website, a representative-gated Developer Center, the Partner Product Portal and Service Center fraud forms.
Friction concentrates in scheduling and review time, retest triggers when anything in the chain changes, and failed certification windows.
Certification for US domestic debit networks, PULSE included, is almost absent from the public record. The industry's shared certification guide leaves those networks out.

how_it_works.text: An issuer must complete certification with Visa to join the Visa Global ATM Network, and US consumer card issuers must join.
An issuer must pass PIN verification certification testing or designate Visa to verify PINs.
A member using a VisaNet Processor files a regional client information questionnaire first. A non-member processor signs a VisaNet Letter of Agreement.
Profile and programme set-up runs through self-service tools in Visa Access: Program Request Management, the electronic CIQ and the Visa Client Support Application.
The bank's own delegated administrators create users in Visa Enrollment Manager, add services and assign a role for each service.
Visa Token Service onboarding material on Visa Developer is restricted to entitled users, so the issuer path is not public.
The issuer centre gives Visa every processing parameter, including routing, PIN and CVV checks and stand-in decisions. It must warn Visa well ahead of any change.
Enrolment in optional V.I.P. services differs by region, and the regional implementation guides come from the Visa representative.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Access (formerly Visa Online)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Password-protected client site claiming 150+ services. Enrolment needs an existing client or partner relationship.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Enrollment Manager Delegated Admin
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Inbox of pending tasks, a History area with activity status, Users menu and exportable inactivity and profile reports.

tools_and_screens.name: Program Request Management, eCIQ and VCSA
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Client Portfolio Management Self-Service Tools for profile, programme and agent records.

friction.text: VEM shows the administrator a temporary password that must be passed to the new user by hand.
Visa Access support sends users to their organisation's local administrators before Visa will help.
Issuers without Visa Access are sent to their Visa account executive to get in.

how_it_works.text: The bank must hold a Mastercard licence and a Company ID before anyone can open a Connect account.
Form 1145 or 1145b names the Security Administrators. It goes by email to a provisioning mailbox, and the administrators receive RSA software tokens by encrypted email.
Staff request each application from the Connect Store and scope it to ICAs, BINs or account ranges. A Security Administrator at the bank approves each order.
For MDES Token Connect the issuer first sends wireframes for Mastercard to review against a design checklist.
The issuer's Customer Delivery Manager then opens a CIS project. CIS grants MTF access and supplies test cases, and friendly-user tests follow in production.
The MDES Issuer Implementation Guide and other manuals sit in the Technical Resource Center behind a Connect login.
Optional issuer services start with a participation form to Customer Operations Services, for example POS Balance Inquiry or Real-time Substantiation.
For M/Chip processing services the issuer asks its Customer Implementation Services specialist to sign up and test, naming the account range covered.
Issuer test cases are chosen by business profile. An issuer adding chip runs only the chip cases, and contactless chip needs contact chip validated first.

tools_and_screens.name: Business Administrator role
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Defines application and data access rules for the company and related companies.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Connect home and My Items
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Welcome bar naming the company's administrators, favourites, a Technical Resource Center link and cards for each application with a pending-items section.

tools_and_screens.name: Connect Store checkout
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Request button per application, then a data access step that can copy scopes from another item.

tools_and_screens.name: Track Status and Help Center
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Order status for access requests, support requests with status, chat and a forms library.

tools_and_screens.name: My Company Manager
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: The bank's Mastercard assets and contacts, including BINs, account ranges and service provider registrations.

tools_and_screens.name: Stand-In application
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Issuer-set stand-in authorisation parameters and rules.

tools_and_screens.name: Issuer Mastercard and Debit Mastercard Test Cases
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Case tables by message type and product, each marked for the simulator or MTF. Chapters cover dual message authorisation, clearing, integrated and single message.

tools_and_screens.name: Testing Reference Information Center (TRIC)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Document set whose Offline Validation and Online Validation manuals say when each test case is run.

friction.text: Nothing can start until licensing is done, since Connect accounts require a licensed company.
SecurID tokens go only to users of higher-security applications, so token set-up varies by role.
Getting a CIS project number usually takes several days, and MTF access waits on it.

how_it_works.text: Issuers perform host and payment product certification with Amex certification teams, using Amex test simulation tools and customised test plans.
Host certification covers unattended testing, telecom connectivity validation and message and file validation.
The Network Specifications needed for host certification sit behind a Knowledge Base login.
GNS User Services processes Knowledge Base access within three business days. FraudNet, OpsNet, File Tracker and the Token Requester Management Portal are requested after that.
Post-signing training is delivered as webinars and online modules requested through the Amex representative.

tools_and_screens.name: Knowledge Base
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Search, bookmarks, a Participant Directory and a Service Enrollment area for enrolling in network services.

tools_and_screens.name: Request Additional Services button
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Adds services such as FraudNet or AMEX Enabled to an existing Knowledge Base user.

friction.text: Urgent operational bulletins are posted inside Knowledge Base, not on a public status page.

how_it_works.text: EASI self-registration lists DN Credit Issuer and DN Debit Prepaid Issuer among its company types, and the EASI team usually reviews within two business days.
Debit issuers register on the PULSE website and receive a User ID within five business days.
A Participant Super User at each institution decides every other user's access to the PULSE Debit Dashboard.
Discover's issuer certification steps are not public. The D-PAS Certification Manual for Issuers and Acquirers is referenced but not published.

tools_and_screens.name: EASI Portal
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Programme documents, test card requests, technical specifications and a Message Center to the operations team.

tools_and_screens.name: PULSE Debit Dashboard
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Portfolio reporting with a BIN chooser, peer comparisons and CSV download, billed monthly after a free period.

friction.text: Password resets for PULSE reporting go through a phone centre or email.
EASI, PULSE and the Service Center fraud products each have their own entry route.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard Connect's Store lets the bank scope each application to ICAs, BINs or account ranges, copy scopes between items and track every order.

discover_today.text: Discover issuers enter through EASI and debit issuers through PULSE, each with its own registration and turnaround. No public source describes issuer certification.

by_partner.partner_type: Issuers: community banks and credit unions

how_it_works.text: Visa's community issuer page routes credit unions and community banks to a product enrolment portal that needs a Visa Online login.
A member using a processor must file the regional client information questionnaire before the processor is used.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Online product enrolment portal
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Enrolment in programmes such as the Merchant Offers Program for community issuers.

friction.text: Visa's public pages still say Visa Online while the rules call the portal Visa Access.

how_it_works.text: A banking-as-a-service platform tells sponsor banks, as principal members, to name a Business Administrator and two Security Administrators on form 1145.
The bank's Business Administrator registers each service provider in Connect and then provisions its applications per ICA.
In a sponsored programme both the programme manager and the issuer processor must be registered as the bank's service providers.

tools_and_screens.name: Mandatory Connect applications for a small issuer
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Business and Security Administration, Data Integrity Online, Location Administration Tool, Mastercom, My Company Manager, Operational Reports and more.

tools_and_screens.name: Location Administration Tool
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Where a bank reports its ATM terminals to stay compliant with Mastercard rules.

friction.text: A small bank inherits the same two-administrator model and form process as a large one.

how_it_works.text: PULSE debit issuers register for the PULSE website and receive credentials within five business days.
Anyone may request Debit Dashboard access, and PULSE customer service obtains the institution's approval on the requester's behalf.

tools_and_screens.name: PULSE client support page
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Separate log-ins for Debit Dashboard, ATM List Manager, Marketing Hub and PULSE Exchange.

friction.text: The Debit Dashboard costs 50 dollars a month after three free months.
PULSE describes its support as continuing after the contract, without a published certification path.

how_it_works.text: NYCE publishes onboarding only as issuer enablement through the existing EFT processor, with no certification stages.

friction.text: The Kansas City Fed reports that smaller institutions struggle to pay core providers to implement updates or new payment rails.

how_it_works.text: A shared-branch network for credit unions publishes a certification step of about six to eight weeks, then testing and staff training.

best_pattern.text: PULSE's customer service fetches the institution's approval for a user who asks for access, so the requester does not chase the super user alone.

discover_today.text: Small debit issuers deal with PULSE through a registration form, a super-user model and a paid dashboard. No public source describes how a credit union certifies with PULSE.

how_it_works.text: Visa L3 testing is self-administered by the acquirer, using an EMVCo-qualified tool connected to VCMS or a Visa-confirmed host simulator.
L3 results go to the Chip Compliance Reporting Tool on Visa Access, except for self-accredited US and LAC acquirers.
Visa requires L3 testing before host testing. Mastercard, Discover and Amex require host certification before terminal testing.
Visa's 2016 host path starts with a CIQ and Global Testing Questionnaire, then VTS-VIP pre-testing reviewed by the Global Client Testing team.
The Visa representative schedules attended testing through VCMS, and a letter confirms success.
Go-live is a second CIQ asking Visa to set production participation flags in the VisaNet Systems Table.
An acquirer registers each third party agent through Program Request Management before any service starts.
Visa tests and certifies each new processing centre before it uses V.I.P. The centre exchanges test messages while Visa checks every message type.
Adding the Visa Token Service is a separate project opened through the regional client support representative. It includes a CIQ and PCR activation in the VisaNet Systems Tables.
Token testing is attended by the Global Client Testing team and covers authorisations, clearing and settlement, and exception processing. Only acquirers that pass may go ahead.

tools_and_screens.name: Chip Compliance Reporting Tool (Visa Access)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Receives the TSEZ report and auto-accepts a fully passed one with a confirmation email.

tools_and_screens.name: VCMS and VTS-VIP
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Visa's certification host and the pre-testing simulator that acts as issuer.

tools_and_screens.name: Digital Partner Services
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Public library of approved products and test tools, with portals for Approval Services, Tap to Phone and technology partners.

tools_and_screens.name: VCMS test keys and loopback stations
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Testing uses Visa-provided or endpoint-provided acquirer working keys. Test stations pair through loopback router sign-on and are rejected if paired with a production station.

tools_and_screens.name: Regional Client Support and Regional Testing Representatives
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Two named Visa contacts, one for VisaNet systems support and one for testing support.

friction.text: Visa issues no letter for L3, so the CCRT email is the only proof.
Visa retired its ADVT and CDET toolkits for L3, while its VMCP app still serves host certification.
In 2016 a Visa Online ID was requested by email to a regional mailbox.
Visa's 2016 guide requires a retest if production starts more than 90 days after testing.
A fee analytics firm reports merchants losing CEDP rates where the acquirer had not finished CEDP certification.
Capabilities are switched on station by station. BASE I rejects a PIN or entry mode the station is not certified to send.
An acquirer not activated for a response code receives a generic decline instead, so gaps in activation look like issuer declines.

how_it_works.text: Host validation (NIV) starts with the account manager. The acquirer licenses MAS or MDFS simulators through Simulator Suite on Connect.
Mastercard builds the case list for each session, and the acquirer sends simulator logs to its implementation specialist for review.
Mastercard offers attended online testing in MTF but does not recommend it.
NIV ends with a TAN letter that can be reused as proof in later implementations.
Terminal testing (M-TIP) starts in the Test Selection Engine, which issues a reference number and test plan from the described configuration.
An accredited M-TIP service provider validates the results and issues the letter of approval on Mastercard's behalf.
Mastercard holds an Acquirer Chip Testing Level for each acquirer. Chip messages from an acquirer not permitted get a format error, with notice before the edit starts.

tools_and_screens.name: Simulator Suite on Mastercard Connect
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Ordering and licensing of the authorisation and debit simulators.

tools_and_screens.name: Test Selection Engine
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Questionnaire on terminal brand, model, EMVCo approvals, kernel and application version that generates the M-TIP plan.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Test Facility
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Pre-production environment reached through an implementation manager.

friction.text: A simulator vendor says Mastercard's pre-certification simulation needs its own application and provisioning.
The same vendor says a failed certification pushes the partner to a new window weeks or months later.

how_it_works.text: Acquirers must certify both host and POS before submitting transactions.
Host certification follows eight representative-led steps and ends with an Authorization and Settlement Test Plan and Certification Summary.
POS certification starts with a request form and device details sent to the relationship manager, who supplies test cases.
The acquirer runs an unattended stage alone, then an attended stage with Amex, which reviews receipts and logs.
Amex closes with a certification letter and the live terminal parameters.

tools_and_screens.name: American Express Test System (ATS)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Free host simulator that shows pass or fail against each test case.

tools_and_screens.name: Payment Test Emulator
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: App usable for contactless-only L3 testing.

tools_and_screens.name: Knowledge Base
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Gated network specifications and implementation guides needed for host certification.

friction.text: Amex's published certification steps all start with the relationship manager.

how_it_works.text: Discover host certification has a D-PAS online authorisation test and a clearing test, run on Discover's designated simulator.
The acquirer sends a host certification request form, and Discover assigns test cases from it.
A separate form registers security officers to receive CA public keys, and all forms come from the implementation manager.
Acquirers see simulator results immediately and need not submit logs, and Discover reviews results within agreed service levels.
Terminal E2E runs through an accredited service provider, which drafts the Letter of Certification for Discover's approval.
Discover gives up to ten full sets of test cards free.
The Terminal E2E Certification Request Form is filled in for each combination of kernel, payment application and terminal-to-acquirer interface. Its answers decide the assigned test cases.
The form lists the events that need terminal certification, such as a new or changed kernel, payment application or chip-related peripheral.

tools_and_screens.name: EASI Portal
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Specifications, developer test card kits, announcements and a Message Center to operations.

tools_and_screens.name: Designated host test simulator
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Self-service host testing with immediate results.

tools_and_screens.name: Release Compliance Tool
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Listed under Test and Certify on the Partner Product Portal.

tools_and_screens.name: Terminal E2E Certification Request Form (DN v7.2)
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Colour-coded worksheet of customer details, scope, Quick Chip choice, expansion brands, kernel approvals, terminal set-up and deployment counts. Red marks wrong entries.

tools_and_screens.name: D-PAS Terminal E2E Letter of Certification
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Project ID, full or recertification, scope, terminal and software, test tool, test plan versions, service provider and a waiver table with expiry dates.

friction.text: Forms and the qualified tool list are obtained from the implementation manager, not downloaded.
Waivers carry an expiry date and cover only terminal certification, so an open host fix must be tracked outside the letter.
Errors in a letter are corrected through a named D-PAS Deployment Manager.

best_pattern.text: Discover's designated simulator lets acquirers test at any time and see results immediately, while Discover reviews within agreed service levels.

discover_today.text: Discover matches peers on self-certification and per-acquirer cases, and gives live simulator results as Amex does with ATS. Its forms come through an implementation manager, and no turnaround is public.

by_partner.partner_type: Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients

how_it_works.text: Visa's Chip Vendor Enabled Service lets third-party vendors run L3 testing for acquirers and their processors.
The self-accreditation programme lets acquirers and processors run L3 on their own, and US members skip submitting reports.
Each acquirer registers a merchant's third party agent separately, so a processor serving many acquirers is registered many times.
From 24 October 2026, US and Canadian members must also disclose the BINs and account ranges each agent uses.
Visa Ready is the certification route for issuer processors, BIN sponsors, programme managers, acquirers and gateways.
A non-client processor needs an executed Exhibit K on file before Visa shares its host specifications.

tools_and_screens.name: Visa Ready and Visa Partner
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Six-step application ending in certification and a public directory listing.

friction.text: Visa Ready Tap to Phone certification typically takes six to twelve months, and lab testing can cost 50,000 dollars or more.

how_it_works.text: M-TIP Fast Track lets an acquirer reuse another acquirer's approval for identical terminals.
Modular M-TIP certifies terminals and host components separately, and certified combinations then deploy without further testing.
Under US Delegated L3 Testing, approved acquirers validate M-TIP internally for their VARs, ISOs and gateways.
Each customer registers its service providers in My Company Manager, with materials due within 30 days and annual revalidation.
A token service provider must pass Mastercard certification before a customer may register it.
Issuer processors certify against each Mastercard release, named by year and quarter.

tools_and_screens.name: My Company Manager
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Service provider registrations, BINs, account ranges and compliance contacts.

friction.text: Service provider registration carries an initial and annual fee whose amounts are not published in the rules.

how_it_works.text: Service providers join AMEX Enabled by registering the company under click-through NDA and terms, enrolling a Knowledge Base user and entering the dashboard.
Registration is free and is not approval, since each product must still pass certification.
Processors using a host simulator other than ATS must meet Approved Solution Provider requirements at their own cost.
Test labs need EMVCo accreditation before they can register for AMEX Enabled accreditation.

tools_and_screens.name: AMEX Enabled Dashboard
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Step-by-step journey position, a document set per product, user invitations and status monitoring.

tools_and_screens.name: Contract Center
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: DocuSign contracts with progress tracked at company and product level.

tools_and_screens.name: Messaging Center
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Document exchange and support from Amex product specialists.

friction.text: The 2022 overview allows five additional users per provider on the dashboard.

how_it_works.text: Under AMTC an acquirer validates its own E2E results, and its service provider is accredited indirectly through that acquirer.
Discover accredits acquirers for AMTC case by case.
Marqeta completes Discover mandate work for its clients without changes on their side.
The request form names the platform, merchants and VAR or gateway, and those details are printed on the letter.
Under the 2011 rules a processor had to be certified before settling funds to merchants.

tools_and_screens.name: Partner Directory
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Products that have passed Discover type approval.

friction.text: The type approval process itself is not described publicly.

how_it_works.text: A POS solution tested once on an acquiring platform generally covers every acquirer on that platform.
Twice-yearly releases need no full recertification unless a network asks. A move to a new message format is a major change that needs the networks involved.

friction.text: Combinations of POS systems, devices and acquirers multiply the certifications one software version needs.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard's Modular M-TIP and Fast Track turn one certification into reusable components across acquirers.

discover_today.text: Discover's AMTC programme accredits processors indirectly and case by case, and processors report few Discover mandate changes. Its type approval steps are not public.

how_it_works.text: The acquirer registers the payfac as a third party agent in Program Request Management before any activity.
Payfacs cannot use the affiliate exemption from registration.

tools_and_screens.name: Program Request Management
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Visa Access application for third party agent and high-integrity-risk merchant registration.

friction.text: Registration is per acquirer, so a payfac with several acquirers is registered by each.

how_it_works.text: The acquirer submits a signed registration request on Mastercard Connect, Mastercard reviews it and an email confirms the payfac may start.
Unregistered service providers expose the customer to assessments of up to 25,000 dollars per 30-day period.
High-risk sponsored merchants must be registered on Connect before transactions are accepted.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Connect registration request
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Signed request from the acquirer, with an email confirmation.

how_it_works.text: Payfacs under 250 million dollars of Amex volume onboard through a certified OptBlue participant, which registers them.
Amex marks participants with a certified payfac channel on its public list.
EASI self-registration lists payment facilitators and ISOs among its company types.

tools_and_screens.name: EASI registration form
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Contact, company, signing authority, functions performed, colleague invites and business purpose.

friction.text: A company already on EASI cannot register again, and the user must email to join the existing profile.
When an ISO buys a portfolio and routes devices through a new gateway, the terminals must be retested.

best_pattern.text: Amex publicly marks which OptBlue participants have a certified payfac channel, so a payfac can see its sponsor's standing.

discover_today.text: Payfacs and ISOs can self-register on EASI. This research found no public Discover payfac registration rule or turnaround beyond that.

how_it_works.text: Independent ATM operators reach networks through an ISO that a sponsor bank registers with each network.
ISOs are bound to network rules by contract and must make the operators they connect comply.
Cardtronics provides network access to third-party ATM owners that lack their own sponsorship.
L3 testing covers ATMs, and it is the acquirer's responsibility.
Adding cash advance or balance inquiry to an ATM needs specific network testing, including host testing.

friction.text: A test-tool vendor estimates ATM end-to-end PCI certification effort at 40 to 50 percent, overlapping Windows 10 migration.

how_it_works.text: Visa's L3 testing applies to ATMs as well as POS terminals.
Visa's Global ATM Planning Guide sets out programme requirements, processing options and certification procedures for ATM participants.

tools_and_screens.name: Chip Compliance Reporting Tool
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Where the ATM acquirer submits L3 results.

how_it_works.text: M-TIP treats an ATM card reader as the Level 1 device under test.
Acquirers must update ATM locations in the Location Administration Tool on Connect every quarter.
Cirrus forwards ATM balance inquiries only to issuers certified by Customer Operations Services for them.

tools_and_screens.name: Location Administration Tool
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Mandatory Connect application for reporting ATM terminal information.

how_it_works.text: PULSE offers ATM acquirers an ATM List Manager log-in and gateway access to many ATM networks in one message format.

tools_and_screens.name: ATM List Manager
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: PULSE log-in for ATM acquirers, listed on the client support page.

friction.text: The industry certification guide leaves out US domestic debit networks such as PULSE.

best_pattern.text: The networks jointly agree which ATM changes need no retest, such as a Level 1 hardware swap without chip impact.

discover_today.text: PULSE gives ATM acquirers a list tool and gateway access. No public source describes PULSE or Discover ATM certification.

how_it_works.text: Fintech Fast Track routes fintechs through BIN sponsors, processors and programme managers.
Programme managers and BIN sponsors can apply to certify their own solutions through Visa Ready.
A programme manager tokenising through Thredd gets a Program Information Form and CIQ from its Visa project contact and completes them with Thredd.

friction.text: Thredd tells the programme manager it owns the token project and must manage the networks, wallets and processor itself.

how_it_works.text: Product Express is a digital onboarding platform with pre-certified partners.
In a sponsored programme the bank registers the programme manager and the processor as service providers in Connect.
For Mastercard Send, fintechs must be registered by a licensed originating institution.
The Mastercard equivalent is a BPMS Parameter Worksheet. Thredd also needs its own Digital Wallet Product Set Up Form.

tools_and_screens.name: Mastercard Engage portal
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Online application, product qualification, franchise screening, IDs and a programme agreement.

how_it_works.text: Through the i2c agreement, fintechs reach Amex through pre-certified processors and bank BIN sponsors.
Marqeta carries Discover mandates for its clients, while Stripe Issuing offers only Visa and Mastercard.

friction.text: Processors absorb most mandate work, and a processor says networks send mandates through technical newsletters four times a year.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard Product Express offers a shelf of pre-certified partners, so a fintech inherits certification it would otherwise run.

discover_today.text: Fintechs reach Discover through processors such as Marqeta. Stripe Issuing does not offer Discover.

how_it_works.text: Going live runs through an in-project Onboarding Dashboard, and certification credentials need a signed contract.
Viewing certification or production credentials needs an emailed one-time password.
Visa's testing team may attend to administer certification.

tools_and_screens.name: Onboarding Dashboard
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Business entity, contacts, project details, environment request, API registration, users and CSR upload.

friction.text: Visa says onboarding can take two weeks or several months.

how_it_works.text: Company verification links a Connect profile or a Company ID, and a Business Relationship Type gates production APIs.
MTF access is requested by emailing the implementation manager, who writes the test plan.
Mastercom publishes service levels for licence loading and key promotion and names an escalation route.

tools_and_screens.name: Form 1145b for Digital Activity Customers
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Wallets and token requestors send the Connect access form to a regional franchise contact.

tools_and_screens.name: Access Manager in Mastercard Connect
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: BIN or ARID entitlements that must exist before a production client ID is mapped.

how_it_works.text: Projects move through To-Do items and Requested and Approved states for each environment.
Amex signs a CSR within five business days and deploys certificates within 72 hours.

tools_and_screens.name: Amex developer project
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: To-Do items for certificate upload, OAuth details and questionnaire, with review states.

friction.text: Each environment's access is granted by manual review, with status by email.

how_it_works.text: Developer Center access starts with a Contact Us form and a Discover representative.
Discover's implementation table gives client and Discover roles from certification boarding to launch.
Test cases arrive during certification boarding.

tools_and_screens.name: Developer Center organisation
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Apps with Sandbox, Certification or Prod API plans.

best_pattern.text: Mastercard's Mastercom checklist states service levels for its own steps and names where to escalate when they slip.

discover_today.text: Discover publishes phases and roles for API work but gates Developer Center access on a representative.

how_it_works.text: Visa makes full chip host support optional for direct-connect merchants.
Merchants connecting directly to Amex must certify, and an uncertified chip POS moves liability to the merchant.

tools_and_screens.name: American Express Test System
tools_and_screens.what_it_shows: Free host simulator open to merchants and processors.

how_it_works.text: Direct-connect merchants follow the same Discover E2E service provider model as acquirers.
Under the 2011 rules a direct merchant certified every new data link, any switch to or between processors and any large system rewrite.
Discover sent certification test scripts with new releases. Chip acceptance and recurring payment data each needed certification before first use.
Test cards arrived with an acknowledgement form for an officer to sign. Expired cards were destroyed and the destruction certified in writing.
Programme enrolment ran through the relationship manager. Discover judged each request and the manager relayed the decision.
Programme merchants must stay on the current Authorization Interface release. Any exception needs Discover approval before participation is approved.

friction.text: Certification did not test every rule, so a certified merchant could still owe noncompliance fees.
Programme documents came only on request from the relationship manager or account executive.
Calendar time in L3 comes from scheduling and reviews by acquirers and networks, and combinations multiply certifications.

best_pattern.text: Amex gives merchants its host simulator free.

discover_today.text: Discover treats direct-connect merchants like acquirers for E2E certification.

design_moves.title: One certification record with an owner on every step
design_moves.move: Keep one project record per partner that both the partner and network staff read. Each step shows its owner, state and sign-off. Show a service level only where the network commits to one.
design_moves.why_advantage: AMEX Enabled and UnionPay show certification progress. In public sources Visa and Mastercard track only access orders and admin tasks, so a shared record would lead them. Visa splits ownership between a client support representative and a testing representative, so each step needs a named role.

design_moves.title: Live simulator results with a committed review
partner_types: Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients
design_moves.move: Build on Discover's designated simulator. Let partners self-test any time, see each case pass or fail, and hand the batch to Discover review under a stated service level.
design_moves.why_advantage: Discover and Amex already give live results, and a vendor reports that failed certification windows cost weeks or months elsewhere. The request form already flags wrong and unexpected entries by colour, so that validation can run in the portal as the partner types.

design_moves.title: A wallet of certification letters
partner_types: Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients
design_moves.move: Store every letter, its tested configuration and its expiry in the record. Let a partner share proof with a client or reuse it on a new implementation.
design_moves.why_advantage: Letters differ by network, Visa gives none for L3, and Mastercard's TAN is reusable. One portable record would save repeat proof. A real D-PAS letter carries a project ID, test plan versions and waivers with expiry dates, so the wallet should track waiver expiry too.

design_moves.title: A retest check before any change
partner_types: Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients
design_moves.move: Turn the networks' agreed retest rules into a check. The partner describes a change and sees whether it is minor, needs internal regression or needs network testing.
design_moves.why_advantage: The rules are published as a forum FAQ with no interactive check. Retest triggers and multiplied certifications are named friction points. Discover's request form already lists the events that trigger terminal recertification, which gives the check a ready rule set.

design_moves.title: Certify once, inherit across clients
partner_types: Processors, gateways and platforms certifying for many clients
design_moves.move: Show which clients inherit a processor's certification and which need their own tests. Let a client accept a processor registration without re-entering it.
design_moves.why_advantage: Visa registers an agent separately per acquirer, while Mastercard's Modular M-TIP and Product Express show reuse works. Thredd's standard token set-up needs no network testing by clients, which shows inheritance already working at processor level.

design_moves.title: Administrator set-up inside the product
partner_types: Issuers: community banks and credit unions
design_moves.move: Let the signatory name administrators in the product with no emailed form. Offer a preset of tools by partner type, and let the partner admin provision its processor with consent.
design_moves.why_advantage: Mastercard uses an emailed form and Visa a hand-passed password. A BaaS platform publishes its own list of the Connect apps a bank needs.

design_moves.title: One door for the Discover family
design_moves.move: Put EASI, PULSE, the Developer Center and fraud product enrolment behind one registration and one record.
design_moves.why_advantage: This brings parity with Visa and Mastercard, which link partner identities. The earlier study infers that sign-in alone is unlikely to win partners.

design_moves.title: The ATM chain in one view
design_moves.move: Show the sponsor bank, ISO, processor and each network registration for an operator's fleet, with location upkeep in the same record.
design_moves.why_advantage: Operators reach networks through sponsors and ISOs, and Mastercard requires quarterly location updates in a separate tool.

design_moves.title: Publish the network's own service levels
design_moves.move: State turnarounds for steps Discover controls, such as access review and result review, with an escalation route. Keep partner-paced durations out.
design_moves.why_advantage: Mastercard and Amex already publish such commitments, and Visa says timing is the first question clients ask.
